post.description: Standard RFC 8628 polling. A code that has expired, been consumed, or been approved by an identity other than the requester is refused and no token is issued (FR-042). get.description: Description, origin, tags, manifest, components, capabilities, version history and dependent profiles for one package (FR-016). The path is the package id, whose two segments are the namespace and the name. Two panels are scoped to the caller: the dependent profiles are exactly the ones this identity may read (FR-044), and each version's `pinnedBy` counts only those — an unscoped count beside a scoped list would leak the existence of private profiles by arithmetic. `capabilities.scanned` distinguishes a version that was scanned and reaches nothing from one that has never been scanned; the two produce identical empty lists, and only that flag tells them apart.
